items.title: Add "cancel" feature to ongoing uploads, & "delete" to saved vids
items.body: **Situation:** After some sucessfull and other failed uploads, the "Submit & Edit" user/private section of the Lab gets full and messy. We have no option to delete unwanted or duplicate videos, yet! **What we need:** **1)** Add a "Cancel" or "X" button to be used while uploading/transcoding (next to "Publish"). **2)** Add a "Delete" button (or "trash icon") next to the "Edit icon" for saved videos (ideally, for published videos too, although that's not required here): **Functionality** for cancelling upload is here: https://github.com/Paratii-Video/paratii-js/issues/298 **Reference design is here**: https://xd.adobe.com/view/8754f846-e4ea-4170-803b-9b5b8b4b872f/screen/52349cc8-1239-4851-9790-64ad7f76fdf0/upload-1920-1/

items.title: Add option to see recovery key on "settings"
items.body:
This should be done after https://github.com/Paratii-Video/paratii-portal/issues/697

We need a way to show the recovery key one more time for our users. I created this design to make this possible.

1- User clicks on Recovery key.
2- User inserts his password (according to his device).

items.title: File size restriction messaging
items.body:
We're currently limited to .mp4 files under 2gb as far as uploads go, but the portal doesn't exactly make that clear. We should add two things:

1 - add <2gb to the (only .mp4 currently supported) notice when uploading
2 - add a specific error prompt when you attempt to upload an unsupported file format or size - it's currently a generic "something went wrong with your file, try to retry" message.

items.title: Add "change password" functionality
items.body:
At the moment, there is no place to change the password!

As per @pedrocasa's design (below), we should first add a second "tab" to the profile, named password, and implement the feature in there.

After this is done, we can move on to allow users to see again their recovery key https://github.com/Paratii-Video/paratii-portal/issues/741

items.title: implement image resize API
items.body:
We'd like something like 

    paratii.vids.thumbnailUrl(id, size)

Where `size` can be either a single number (`720`) denoting the width, or a (?) bounding box like `100:200`.


These are @ya7ya 's specs to get the thumbs:
```
mage resize API
example :
https://uploader.paratii.video/api/v1/thumbnail/resize?url=https://portal.paratii.video/assets/img/landing/header/yunta.png&size=480:-1

notes:
the -1 in size parameter is to maintain the aspect ratio. so if you want a 720p thumb, size=720:-1
use FULL url, not relative ones

this also has a caching mechanism in place. so it gets way faster after first load.

https://uploader.paratii.video/api/v1/thumbnail/resize?url=<img_url>&size=<output_size_in_ffmpeg_format>
bear in mind that this is a temporary fix till i properly implement multi-resolution thumbnails on transcoding..
```
